ev.q: A total of 210 xylazine-associated deaths were reported during the study period.
Other common co-occurring substances included diphenhydramine ( 78.1% ), cocaine ( 41.9% ), and quinine ( 33.8% ).
Number of xylazine-involved deaths (A) and percentage of fentanyl-involved deaths with detectable xylazine (B), by month
Fentanyl or fentanyl analogs were detected on forensic testing in most xylazine-involved deaths ( 99.1% ).
Naloxone was detected in 33.3% of xylazine-associated deaths.
Xylazine-associated deaths increased throughout the study period; incidence peaked during October 2021
analyzed suspected substance-related deaths from January 2017 to October 2021

methods_quotes.q: A xylazine-associated death was defined as a positive postmortem xylazine serum toxicology test result in an unintentional, undetermined, or pending intent substance-related death
Routine postmortem tests were conducted for other substances including fentanyl, fentanyl analogs, cocaine, and naloxone.
